title: Spell the chord
summary: Note tiles tapped into slots to spell a chord, checked as a set.
content:
## Stacking thirds

A major triad is a root, a major third and a perfect fifth: D major is D, F sharp and A.

## Spelling counts

G flat sounds like F sharp, but a third above D is written with an F. Each letter is used once, every other letter.

quiz.explanation: D major is D, F sharp and A. G flat sounds the same as F sharp, but the third of D is an F.
A minor is A, C and E: a minor third, then a major third.

quiz.prompt: Spell G7, the dominant seventh on G.
quiz.explanation: G7 is a G major triad, G B D, with a minor seventh, F, on top.
